name: ZazaG Dev Sticker board
about: The single source for the channel's look. Edit this file, then run: node design-system/build.mjs (it writes tokens.css). Pages read tokens.css; scripts and renderers read this file.

roles.ill-*: drawn illustrations (the phone menu's card drawings): the light-mode colours in both themes, so a drawing looks the same on dark cards (owner's pick A, #2129, 2026-10-30)
roles.bg: page background, cream paper with a dot grid
roles.muted: secondary text, captions, labels; 4.5:1 or more on bg, card and every pastel in both themes (darkened 2026-10-08 for contrast)
roles.yt: YouTube pastel, also the first highlight
roles.lx: LinkedIn or X pastel, also the second highlight
roles.li: LinkedIn pastel, also today and success notes
roles.bd: Build pastel (app releases), apart from YouTube red; added 2026-10-11 for the challenge day card
roles.pop: the one loud accent: badges, primary buttons, today
roles.on-pop: text on pop (buttons, the day badge, the live tag): dark ink, 5.2:1 or more; white failed on this orange
roles.go-ink: green text such as "live, updated" (go itself is too light for text on white)
roles.scrim: the dark see-through layer over the page while a pop-up is open (with a light blur where the browser supports it); added 2026-10-11
roles.screen: dark stage behind game art and app screenshots on the app pages, in both themes; added 2026-10-29 (#2117)
roles.on-screen-muted: secondary text on screen, 4.5:1 or more

promo.about: The drawn product promos (first the AgentDeck promo v3 kit in motion/kit/agentdeck-promo-v3, 2026-10-15). scale: a 1920x1080 frame draws every web size (border, corner, shadow) at this multiple. codeBarOpacity: code is drawn as bars in muted at this opacity on card, never as text. dim: what the rest of the frame fades to while the camera holds one focus.

dark.about: The dark promos (AgentDeck promo v4, approved storyboard 2026-10-16): term is a terminal's screen, body the window body behind the panes, both darker than color.dark.card. The ground carries a dot grid of color.dark.muted dots at gridOpacity, gridDot px across, every gridStep px.

shortBand.about: The caption band across the top of a Short: white text on solid black, hook words in color.light.pop. Replaced the white band with black text on 2026-10-14 (TASK #245).
